economics.protection-data.0001.b: Domestic producers gain market share/output -> jobs protected; protects against dumping (below cost); possible improvement in balance of trade (fewer imports); infant/strategic food security.
economics.protection-data.0001.c: For: protects jobs, counters dumping, food security, current account. Against: higher rice prices for consumers (staple), less choice, inefficiency, retaliation, no gov revenue unlike tariff. Judgement depends on dumping scale, elasticity, duration.

economics.protection-data.0017.b: Price of imports rises; quantity of imports falls; domestic producers increase supply/output, higher price; consumers pay more, quantity demanded falls; gov revenue. Diagram with world price + tariff.
economics.protection-data.0017.c: Protects jobs in domestic panel production; but costs rise for firms using panels (installers) -> job losses there; retaliation hits exporters; inefficiency; depends on elasticity, size of domestic industry. Judgement.

economics.protection-assess-1.0001.all: Benefits: domestic tyre producers gain sales, jobs, protects against dumping, improves trade balance. Costs: higher prices for consumers and firms using tyres, less choice, retaliation, inefficiency. Judgement on whether dumping justifies it/short-term.
